Players Committee card image of [[Black 5]] (original printing), game text: “May add DS-61-5 as pilot. During battle, if about to be lost before the damage segment, is instead 'hit.' If targeted by Watch Your Back!, it is a Used Interrupt. Immune to Don't Get Cocky and attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/black5.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
